title: 第19章 童青山出关第20章 天生异柄的小葡萄
content_zh:
墨曦很不解，为什么墨老说，吃了妖墟的肉，就不能离开妖墟了？
在来妖墟的时候，墨曦只听墨老说，妖墟的禁忌很多。
例如，他们绝对不可以吃妖墟的妖。
例如，他们不可以在村子里伤人，要对守护神保持敬畏。
但墨曦发现，妖墟内的生灵，就没有这种禁忌，一些强大的部族，经常猎妖为食物，他们甚至会进入别的村庄烧杀劫掠。
有些大妖，也会闯入村庄，把所有人杀死，看起来肆无忌惮。
只有他们这种外来人，需要遵循各种禁忌。
现在，听到爷爷又说起这些禁忌，墨曦自然不解。
墨老则回答道：“妖墟很诡异，在妖墟，有一种十分罕见的现象，叫做污染。”
“可是，枣叶村的他们，并没有被污染啊。”墨曦说道。
墨老则叹道：“妖墟的原住民，只要吃过一次开了命井的妖，就已经被污染了。”
“不会吧！”墨曦惊呼。
墨老叹道：“之前我就怀疑，他们可能吃过妖，否则，一些普通人，怎么可能成长到如此地步。”
“现在看来，他们果然有稀释妖肉的办法，他们已经吃过妖了。”
墨曦皱眉：“难道，只要吃了妖肉，就一定会被污染？”
墨老点头：“没错，他们的体内，已经种下了污染的种子。”
“或许，只要不离开妖墟，那些污染不会显现出来，他们甚至可以正常的修炼，可以娶妻生子。”
“但是，一旦他们离开妖墟，那种污染，必然会爆发。”
说到这里，墨老的神色中全是惋惜：“哎，这些人……太可惜了，明明拥有了如此高的起点和资质，但被污染了，永远都无法离开妖墟。”
“污染，没有办法清除吗？”墨曦很不甘心的问道。

这个少女很善良，她实在不忍心，看张楚这些人走上歧路。
墨老回答道：“没办法清除！”
“实际上，很多年前，也有名门或者世家，从妖墟找到过修炼天才，想要好好培养。”
“但是，只要这些人离开妖墟，都会立刻被污染。”
“偏偏，他们自己感觉不到。”
说到这里，墨老仿佛回忆起了什么惋惜的往事，他摇摇头：“我们走吧，不要跟他们有太多的交集，否则，徒增伤感。”
“可是，昨天晚上，我们也吃了他们给的食物啊，我们也会被污染吗？”墨曦还是不愿意离去。
墨老则开口道：“在妖墟，吃普通的肉没问题，但不能吃妖。”
紧接着墨老说道：“这一路行来，我们杀了不少妖，但从来不动它们的肉，也不碰它们的妖丹，就是这个道理。”
“走吧，吃了妖肉的妖墟人，这一生，都不可能离开妖墟的。”
墨老和墨曦，这一次是真的离去了。
……
小村里，张楚却陷入了疑惑。
这几天，张楚频频接近突破，他甚至感觉，睡觉的时候，都有莫名的灵力聚集在自己身边，仿佛等待着张楚的调用。
content_en:
Mo Xi was puzzled, why did Mr. Mo say that if he ate the meat of the Demon Xu, he could not leave the Demon Xu?
When she came to Yaoxu, Mo Xi only heard from Mr. Mo that there were many taboos in Yaoxu.
For example, they must not eat the demons from the demon ruins.
For example, they are not allowed to hurt anyone in the village and must remain in reverence for the patron saint.
But Mo Xi discovered that the creatures in the demon ruins did not have such taboos. Some powerful tribes often hunted demons for food, and they would even enter other villages, burn, kill and loot.
Some big monsters will also break into the village and kill everyone, seemingly unscrupulous.
Only outsiders like them need to follow various taboos.
Now, hearing her grandfather talk about these taboos again, Mo Xi was naturally puzzled.
Mr. Mo replied: "The Demonic Ruins are very strange. In the Demonic Ruins, there is a very rare phenomenon called pollution."
"But they in Zaoye Village are not polluted." Mo Xi said.
Mr. Mo sighed: "As long as the aborigines of the demon ruins have eaten the demon that opened the life well once, they have been polluted."
"No way!" Mo Xi exclaimed.
Mr. Mo sighed: "I suspected before that they might have eaten monsters. Otherwise, how could some ordinary people grow to such an extent."
"Now it seems that they really have a way to dilute the demon meat. They have already eaten the demon."
Mo Xi frowned: "Could it be that as long as you eat demon meat, you will definitely be contaminated?"
Mr. Mo nodded: "Yes, the seeds of pollution have been planted in their bodies."
"Maybe, as long as they don't leave the demon ruins, the pollution won't show up, and they can even practice normally, get married and have children."
"But once they leave the demon ruins, that kind of pollution will inevitably break out."
At this point, Mr. Mo's expression was full of regret: "Hey, these people... What a pity. They obviously have such a high starting point and qualifications, but they are contaminated and can never leave the demon ruins."
"Is there no way to clean up the pollution?" Mo Xi asked reluctantly.
This girl is very kind, but she really can't bear to see people like Zhang Chu go astray.
Mr. Mo replied: "There is no way to clear it!"
"Actually, many years ago, some famous or aristocratic families found cultivation geniuses from the Demon Ruins and wanted to train them well."
"However, as long as these people leave the demon ruins, they will be contaminated immediately."
"But, they can't feel it themselves."
Speaking of this, Mr. Mo seemed to recall some regrettable past events. He shook his head: "Let's go. Don't have too much interaction with them. Otherwise, it will only increase the sadness."
"But, last night, we also ate the food they gave us. Will we also be contaminated?" Mo Xi still didn't want to leave.
Mr. Mo then said: "In the Demon Ruins, it's okay to eat ordinary meat, but you can't eat monsters."
Then Mr. Mo said: "We have killed many demons along the way, but we have never touched their flesh or their demon elixirs. That's why."
"Let's go. The people of Yaoxu who have eaten demon meat will never leave Yaoxu in this life."
Mr. Mo and Mo Xi really left this time.
…
In the small village, Zhang Chu fell into doubt.
In the past few days, Zhang Chu had been approaching breakthroughs frequently. He even felt that when he was sleeping, there was inexplicable spiritual power gathering around him, as if waiting for Zhang Chu to call him.
